main_text.p: ὁρμάω ῶ ruo, irruo, impetu feror, prorumpo. Fut. ἤσω. P. ὡρμήνοι. aor.1. act. ὥρμησα. pass. ὡρμήμην ad aliquid agendum incitatus fui.
ὄρνις ιϑος ὁ ἡ ales, avis. per syn.gen. gallina.
ὄρνεον τὸ vólucris, avicula. diminutivum ab ὄρνις ιϑος ὁ ἡ.
Ὁροϑεσία ας ἡ (q.d. Ὅρος ϑ ὀρθρositio termini) terminus positus.
ὄρος ὲος τὸ mons: At ὄρος ϑ ὁ terminus.
ὀρύσσω vel Attice ὀρύττω fodio. F. ὀρύξω. P. ὤρυγα. a.1. ὤρυξα. a.2. ὤρυγον.

ὀρφανὸς ὁ orphanus, pupillus, orbus parentibus. ab ἀφνὸς obscurus. q.d. ὁ ἐν σκότῳ ὢν. Negligitur enim & veluti in tenebris versatur. Th. ὀρφνὴ ῆς ἡ tenebrae. Flectitur more adjectivorum Exod.22. v.24. τὰ ποιδία ὀρφανά.
ὀρχέομαι ὄρχημαι salto. Fut. ὀρχήσομαι. a.1. med. ὀρχησάμην ω ἀλ. part.a.1.med. ὀρχησάμενος η ον, Marc.6.22.

ὅς ἥ ὅ qui, quae, quod, welcher / welche / welches. dicitur ἄρθρον ὑποθετικὸν... postpositivus, quòd nominibus postponatur: est q; vice relativi, & semper sequitur verbum aut expressum aut subintellectum, Actor.27.44. Rom.14.5. ὅς μὲν ὅς ὁ pro ἕτος μὲν ὀκεῖνος δὲ, Luc.7.45. ἀφ' ἧς (subaudi ὥρας) ex quo tempore.

page.notes: Right margin strip is a neighbouring page (cut off, partly illegible); its Greek and Latin marginal fragments are not transcribed. Greek transcription is approximate in places; accents and some letters may be misread. Bottom "ὅσγ" appears to be a catchword, though it may be a partial word.
